reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited pricing paragraphs (§ 3(a)-(b)) contain only time-and-materials compensation, expense reimbursement, invoicing detail and a rate-change notice — no obligation for Company/Clear Capital to extend RadialSpark terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, and no obligation to match third-party offers.
No MFN in the Vendor's favour exists anywhere in the cited text, so the preferred position (no MFN burden on Customer) is met and there is nothing to delete.

The rationale correctly parks the uncapped 30-day rate-change right as an informational note for the price-increase rule rather than double-flagging it here, consistent with the no-duplicate-flagging instruction.
